result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by retaining 12-month automatic renewals while allowing non-renewal on 30 days’ notice, which is within the maximum 60-day window. It does not introduce any right to increase renewal pricing, so it does not permit increases above the fallback cap. The change is narrow and preserves the separate 90-day convenience-termination right during renewal terms. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the Vendor’s 60-day renewal reminder.
